BearWitnessTHP00.description: Order (Tessavain). At the start of EVERY round, each of your Covenant allies within your Attunement Range (White) gains Temp HP equal to your White rank (keeps-higher; Temp HP does not stack). 07-24u: replaced edhaOrderRoundTick and its three bespoke combat hooks per iron rule 2b. Two builds made it expressible -- `whenMoment: round-start` on the edha-combat-timing dispatcher (with the generic round-boundary latch and its mid-combat-reload guard), and `target: list-members`, which reads the H3 `covenants` ledger directly instead of re-deriving it from a name-keyed owner scan. The amount was edhaColorRank(owner, 'white') in engine code and is now the formula below, so it is editable in Foundry. A White rank of 0 grants nothing and posts no card, as before.

Cost: 2 Investiture

Two voices, one law. Many hands, one work.

Spend 2 Investiture. For the scene, your active Covenants form a Concord: an ally in a Covenant with you may, as a Free Action on its turn, grant any other Covenant ally the benefit of the Aid action, and each Covenant ally's first attack each round deals additional damage equal to your Presence.

description.value:
Activation: 1

Cost: 1 Investiture

The hands met. The promise was older than either of them.

Spend 1 Investiture and touch a willing ally; you and that ally enter a Covenant for the scene. While the Covenant holds, you and the ally each gain +1 to all defenses when within Attunement Range of each other, and may use the Aid action targeting each other at any range within Attunement Range. A Covenant ends if either party deliberately attacks the other. You may sustain up to your tier active Covenants.

CovenantPact0000.description: Order (Tessavain). The pact: the targeted ally joins your `covenants` ledger and bears the Covenant marker for the scene. 07-24u: replaced a preUseItem TAKEOVER (edhaOrderCovenant) per iron rule 2b, and every dial the takeover hard-coded is a field here. `multiOwner` because the covenant icon is SHARED between Order PCs -- without it one owner's fizzle strips another owner's icon. `sceneScoped: false` because the pact follows the ally, not the ground. requireDisposition + requireAdjacent enforce 'target the willing ALLY' and 'Covenant requires touch' BEFORE any cost is paid, so the takeover's 'nothing spent' guarantee survives its retirement.

handler.note: +1 to all defenses while within Attunement Range (White) of each other (auto). Each of you may take the Aid action targeting the other at any range within Attunement Range (execute by hand). It ends if either deliberately attacks the other.

effects.description: Copied onto BOTH partners while they stand within Attunement Range (White) of each other: +1 to all defenses. Edit the numbers here -- the Order proximity sweep reads this effect (iron rule 2b, 07-24u). transfer: false, so it never applies on its own.

Cost: 1 Investiture

He spoke the rule once. The world wrote it down.

Spend 1 Investiture and place an Edict on a character in Attunement Range, declaring one prohibited action (move from its space, attack a chosen ally, activate Investiture, etc.). The first time the bound character takes the prohibited action, it takes [Tier][Die] + Intellect spirit damage and is Disoriented until the start of your next turn; the Edict is then consumed. You may sustain up to your tier Edicts; unviolated Edicts fade at the end of the scene.

Cost: 3 Investiture

The law was not written today. It was only finally spoken.

Spend 3 Investiture and name one prohibited action that applies to every enemy in Attunement Range as if bound by your Edict; each ally in a Covenant with you is named a Witness. The first time any bound enemy takes the prohibited action, every active Edict you have immediately triggers, every Witness gains [Tier][Die] temporary HP and an advantage on its next attack test, and each enemy within 10 ft of the violator takes [Tier][Die] + Intellect spirit damage. Once per scene.
